title: Dynamical locality · registered joint decision
description: Every one of the 12 size/parameter cells has zero joint successes out of 12 preparations. The finite unconditioned labeled-locality screen is NO-GO; geometry and a continuum remain unresolved.
uncertainty: Exact two-sided Clopper–Pearson bounds with total familywise alpha=.05 across 12 cells. The primary upper bound is .40218992470918974. Stricter GO and degree-null bounds are separate columns. Component counts are descriptive, without invented component intervals.
sampleUnit: 12 independent E preparations per size/parameter cell, three batches of four. Source-target pairs, delays, perturbations and Born graphs stay inside that one preparation unit. Deterministic symmetric preparations do not enter these binomial counts.
assumptions: C: connected Born mass; L: concentrated nonzero response; T: ensemble/perturbation stability; D: improvement over initially frozen links. These practical necessary conditions are not a universal definition of locality or a spacetime classifier.
selection: All 12 summary.json cells, including component counts and both exact interval families. mu/Gamma join the hash-pinned raw archive by(N,cell). success_fraction is successes/attempted; no confidence fit or decision is recomputed.
